title: Effect of Oxygen Supplementation During Exercise in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Patients
brief_summary: The project will test the hypothesis that lung ventilation during exercise is unaffected by oxygen supplementation. In addition, the acute effect of oxygen supplementation on dyspnoea, heart rate and blood pressure will be studied.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* No exacerbation
* No active heart disease
